title: Change mark rates across proposal lines
steps: Inspect the two free-text service lines, their buying costs, selling prices, and 20% mark rates.
Click the edit icon in the Mark rate column header and enter 25%.
Click Update and inspect the resulting line prices, buying costs, mark rates, proposal total, and feedback.

video_guide.summary: Watch the same bulk update produce the new prices without a contradictory parameter error.

chapters.note: The proposal starts with the same two service lines and 20% mark rates.
The bulk mark-rate editor contains 25 beside Update.
The refreshed lines show 25% and totals EUR106.67 and EUR53.33; costs remain EUR80 and EUR40.
The total selling price is EUR160 and no parameter-error notification is visible.
